queries.monthly_trend: SELECT segments.year,segments.month,metrics.cost_micros,metrics.impressions,metrics.clicks,metrics.conversions,metrics.all_conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2019-01-01' AND '2026-07-31' ORDER BY segments.year,segments.month
queries.genuine_leads: SELECT segments.month,segments.conversion_action_category,metrics.conversions FROM customer WHERE segments.date BETWEEN '2025-09-01' AND '2026-07-31' AND segments.conversion_action_category IN ('PHONE_CALL_LEAD','SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM','BOOK_APPOINTMENT')

conversion_actions_summary.note: Genuine count = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM. Phone calls are the dominant genuine action; form submissions are a small trickle (0-1/mo).
excluded: Arrange A Free Consultation - Clicks (BOOK_APPOINTMENT button click - 0 counted)
Local actions - Directions/Website visits/Menu views/Other engagements

detected_takeover: Launch ~Sep 2025 (Method B). No account data before 2025-09; the first month runs a full ~$720 budget and 24,590 impressions, indicating PPC Guru launched the program in September 2025. Budget has stayed flat (~$700-810/mo) since.
notes: Short history: 11 months (Sep 2025 - Jul 2026). Confidence Medium.

Genuine leads = PHONE_CALL_LEAD + SUBMIT_LEAD_FORM. metrics.conversions ~= genuine phone leads; metrics.all_conversions is heavily inflated from Apr 2026 (e.g. 2026-05 conv 84 vs allConv 489) by Google local actions and button clicks (Arrange consultation / Pop Up) - excluded.
'Then' = first complete month Sep 2025: 55 genuine leads, $724.22 spend, CPL $13.17, conv rate 14.3%.
'Now' = Q2 2026 (Apr-Jun): 286 genuine leads (avg 95.3/mo), $2,287.08 spend (avg $762.36/mo), CPL $8.00, genuine-lead conv rate 22.1%.
Full quarters under management: Q4 2025 (179), Q1 2026 (291), Q2 2026 (286). Q3 2025 partial (Sep only).
